digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, LLM runner, workflow execution
propositions: code-review.yaml declares per-step model classes (frontier/standard) on five LLM steps; all declarations are silently ignored at runtime and every step executes on the single resolved cfg.model
PydanticAIRunner.run discards req.config and resolves the model from self._config only, causing per-step model overrides passed by RunnerAgentStep to be ignored
usage_log records only op (prompt name) and cannot attribute calls to steps; code-review-base is used by both base step and batch finder, making nine-call logs unattributable without step id
the per-step model value computed by RunnerAgentStep and passed via req.config.model never reaches resolve_model or the actual LLM invocation
